results.criterion: Duplicate digest is idempotent and out-of-order or conflicting owner revision does not overwrite newer state.

results.criterion: 1440, 1280, 390, 320 and 200-percent zoom plus light, dark, high contrast, reduced motion and keyboard navigation pass.
